_comment: Single source of truth for the Beetle PSX (mednafen-psx libretro) oracle pin.
beetle_oracle.py reads this. Bump upstream_base only together with
regenerated hook patches:  cd <checkout> && git diff <new base> -- <file> ...
Upstream master was converted from C++ to plain C (libretro.cpp -> libretro.c,
PS_CPU class dropped) after this commit, and no longer compiles against
runtime/src/beetle_libretro.cpp. This is the last C++-tree base we target.
upstream_base_subject: Beetle PSX libretro: audit pass - exceptions, leaks, hardening, dead code

bios.note: mednafen-psx looks for a lowercase per-region BIOS filename in the BIOS directory. Only the prefix is recorded: psxrecomp/docs/beetle-linux.md gives '0555C6FA...' truncated, and the full digest has NOT been verified against a dump here. Verify and complete before gating on it.
